blind.description: A miniature ornate golden reliquary shaped like an upright forearm and open hand (or gauntlet/blessing hand). It has a stepped circular base decorated with red and green inset jewels, tapering up through an ornate sleeve/arm section to an open golden palm with four upright fingers and an outstretched thumb. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and continuous with no holes, shards, or floating elements. It sits flat on its integrated circular pedestal base. The material is polished gold adorned with green patterns and red/green gems.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a small concentric circular golden base with the top edges of the aligned fingertips and palm visible in the center, casting a hand-shaped shadow towards the top-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/5 the height of the figure (around 1 foot / 30-35 cm tall), and roughly 1/3 as wide as the figure's diameter.

notes: base is somewhat broader than catalog proportions (height is 2x base width instead of 3.5x)
